description: Expose Aegra as v1 for supported new chats while preserving legacy v0 for unsupported interactions and existing threads on experiment/aegra.

userStories.title: Expose the Aegra v1 agent API
acceptanceCriteria: First add failing route tests for Aegra thread creation and run streaming under `/api/v1`.
An authorized client creates a thread with `POST /api/v1/threads` and streams a run with `POST /api/v1/threads/{thread_id}/runs/stream` using Aegra-native payloads and events.
An unauthenticated request to each v1 route returns `401`; a second user cannot read or run the first user's thread.
Legacy `POST /api/llm/stream` and `/api/threads/search` retain their existing payloads and behavior.
The frontend proxy directs `/api/v1` to the Aegra service and legacy `/api` to the Orchestra backend.
The experiment exposes no permanent duplicate Aegra contract under `/api/aegra` after v1 clients move.
userStories.description: As an API client, I want Aegra threads and runs under `/api/v1` so that I can distinguish them from legacy `/api` operations.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: worker red route test exit 1 before implementation. 2 executed: advisor independently ran bash backend/scripts/test-aegra-chat-stream.sh on the integrated task branch, exit 0, 3 passed; task-created database dropped and absence verified. 3 executed: focused test asserts unauthenticated 401 and second-user read/run denial. 4 reasoned: git diff against experiment/aegra changes no legacy route or payload files; full backend CI will verify before PR ready. 5 reasoned: reviewed Vite proxy ordering: /api/v1 targets port 2026 before /api targets Orchestra; browser route review remains in US-002 and US-004. 6 executed: focused test asserts old /api/aegra route returns 404. userStories.title: Select an engine before new-thread creation
acceptanceCriteria: First add failing UI tests for a new text chat with an authorized tool and for new chats with files, MCP, A2A, subagents, public assistants, or a custom system prompt.
Before any thread creation request, the UI selects v1 for a supported text interaction with authorized Orchestra tools.
Before any thread creation request, the UI selects legacy v0 when the interaction requests a feature that v1 does not support; the legacy request keeps that feature's input.
Each thread keeps one engine for later turns; a failed or interrupted v1 run never retries through `/api/llm/stream`.
Existing legacy threads stay on their existing routes. No request dual-writes thread, run, or checkpoint state.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
userStories.description: As a chat user, I want supported interactions on v1 and unsupported ones on v0 so that legacy features remain available.

userStories.title: Recover engine ownership after reload
acceptanceCriteria: First add failing tests that clear `localStorage` before opening one v1 thread and one legacy thread.
The UI discovers authorized v1 threads through Aegra thread search or an equivalent server-owned record; it does not use `localStorage` as the authority for engine ownership.
After a reload without local markers, opening a v1 thread reads its Aegra state and opening a legacy thread reads its existing Orchestra state.
A second user cannot discover or read the first user's v1 thread through the new lookup path.
The UI does not send a v1 thread identifier to legacy checkpoint search or write a legacy thread row for it.
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill.
userStories.description: As a returning user, I want server-owned thread routing so that reloads and other devices cannot send a thread to the wrong store.

userStories.title: Review both paths and clean up
acceptanceCriteria: After operator approval for disposable resources, record redacted commands, HTTP statuses, and annotated screenshots in `.agro/tasks/aegra-v1-migration/evidence/manual-review.md`.
In agent-browser, create a v1 thread, invoke an Orchestra tool, see its result and streamed reply, and send a second turn.
In agent-browser, create a new thread with one unsupported feature and observe the legacy v0 path retain that input.
Reload with browser-local ownership flags cleared; confirm both threads open under their original engines.
Stop only review processes and delete only task-created disposable databases; verify their absence.
userStories.description: As an operator, I want observed v0 and v1 journeys so that I can decide whether the experiment is ready for further parity work.
